title: The Whistleblower
briefing: A driver has told the regulator and a newspaper that fatigue rules are being ignored at Corby Road. The story runs tomorrow. The CEO wants to 'find out who it was'.
As Head of Risk you advise the executive.

evidence.title: The allegation
evidence.body: Drivers at Corby Road routinely work beyond Valtren's own fatigue rules; supervisors falsify rosters.

evidence.title: What your data shows
evidence.body: Corby Road's fatigue KRI has been amber for 9 weeks; roster edits after shifts are 6x other depots.

evidence.title: Legal note
evidence.body: Whistleblowers are protected by law; retaliation or attempts to identify them create legal liability.

questions.prompt: How do you respond to 'find out who it was'?

options.label: Advise firmly against it: it is unlawful, and the data suggests the claim is true; focus on the allegation
options.feedback: Protects the whistleblower, the company and the CEO.

options.label: Review roster access logs quietly to understand who raised it, without taking any action against them
options.feedback: Unlawful and likely to be discovered.

options.label: Pass the request to HR, who handle employee relations and know the legal position

questions.prompt: How should the allegation be investigated?

options.label: An independent investigation reporting to the Audit Committee chair, with roster and tachograph data preserved
options.feedback: Independence is essential when management is implicated.

options.label: The Corby Road site manager investigates, since he knows the rosters and the drivers best and can act quickly
Issue a firm denial: the company's fatigue rules are clear and published
options.feedback: Your own data supports the claim.

questions.prompt: What does Valtren say to the newspaper?

options.label: "We take this seriously, have started an independent investigation, are enforcing rest rules at Corby Road, and protect staff who raise concerns."
"Valtren's fatigue rules exceed legal requirements, every roster is checked by a supervisor, and we have no evidence that they are being breached."
"We do not comment on matters under internal review."

questions.prompt: What immediate action at Corby Road?

options.label: Enforce rest rules tonight, audit rosters, and require a second approval for roster edits
Keep operations unchanged until the investigation reports, to avoid acting on an unproven claim
Close Corby Road temporarily until the investigation is complete

lesson: A whistleblower is a warning system working. Protect the person, investigate independently, fix the danger now, and treat the allegation on its evidence.

escalation.text: Nobody from risk picked up "The Whistleblower" in time. The executive team handled it alone, late and without a plan, and the damage spread.
